run_coreference_resolution_cli: run the CLI to resolve coreferences in a gzipped dataset and save results to a JSON file
resolve_coreferences_function: create a function that resolves coreferences in text using spacy fastcoref and LingMessCoref model
resolve_coreferences_for_dataset_functio: build a function that resolves coreferences for all episode instructions in a dataset and returns episode ID to resolved text mapping
review_resolve_coreferences: review the resolve_coreferences function that uses spacy and fastcoref to replace pronouns with their antecedents
summarize_main: summarize the main function that loads a gzipped dataset, resolves coreferences, and saves the output as JSON
